Hi Maya — really appreciate the clear ask and the projection file. Quick summary below, attaching a compact pricing sheet and a sample pilot scope.

High‑level options (short):
1) Pay‑as‑you‑go (metered): per‑GB ingest for tracing, per‑GB for logs/metrics; retention billed as storage tiers (30/90/365) with proportional per‑GB rate. Best for unpredictable usage.
2) Slab / committed capacity: monthly commit for tracing ingest and retention; gives 20–30% effective savings versus PAYG depending on commit level. Includes soft overage cushion for spikes.
3) Bundled seat + metric: includes N dashboard seats + XGB/month tracing allotment + retention tier at discount. Good if you want fixed budgeting and a single invoice line.

Pilot concession (we can offer):
- 6,000 USD pilot credit toward add‑ons + 30 days of complimentary advanced dashboard seats for the POC.
- If you convert to a 12‑month commit covering expected Q4 spikiness, we can layer a one‑time onboarding credit equal to 10% of the first year add‑on spend.

SLA note: retention snapshots/archival are covered under our observability SLA except for customer‑managed archival in air‑gapped/private deployments. I attached the SLA excerpt (see page 2 of the pricing PDF).

Next steps: if you can confirm estimated monthly ingest and desired retention horizon (30/90/365) we’ll run a small model and show exact ARR and per‑token economics. Would you be open to a 30 min call Wednesday to walk procurement through the options?

Thanks,
Markus Klein

Hi Maya / Clearline procurement — thanks for the clear priorities. After internal review here’s a concise, executable offer we can present to your CFO: 

Offer summary (clean bullets):
- Commitment term: 12 months for observability add‑ons (retention + tracing + dashboards).
- Commit level: equivalent to projected 5M tokens/month (we modeled anticipated Q4 spike into the commit band).
- Pricing: 20% off list for Advanced Dashboards (applies to dashboard seats and dashboard‑linked storage fees). Tracing ingest and retention given a blended slab price (see attached pricing sheet for exact per‑GB values).
- Pilot credit: 10,000 USD applied to add‑on invoices during POC (applies if signed contract is returned within 45 days of offer).
- Overage policy: deterministic billing — ingest continues; overage billed at the agreed overage per‑GB in the slab (no silent throttling). We’ll trigger automated alerts at 80%, 95% of commit and require written confirmation for temporary ingestion suspension requests.
- SLA: retention is included in the observability SLA; archival in customer‑managed private deployments has different recovery windows (see SLA excerpt page in the pricing PDF).

Commercial caveats: 25% dashboard discount requires a cross‑commit including core hosted API spend (we can discuss), or a 24‑month term. The 20% offer is our standard enterprise concession for a 12‑month add‑on commit at the modeled volume.
